mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, COUNT(a.id) AS articleCount FROM sys_series s LEFT JOIN sys_article a ON a.series_id = s.id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.description ORDER BY s.sort ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.quantity, a.is_stick, a.is_recommend, a.status, a.create_time, a.series_id, c.name AS categoryName, se.name AS seriesName, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM sys_article a LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_series se ON a.series_id = se.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.series_id = #{seriesId} ORDER BY a.create_time ASC
